audits.purpose: Close remaining apparent 2024 inventory gaps where a permit or modern Existing/Potential label could otherwise be misread as proof of target-year operation.
audits.operational_gate: A permit, planning consent, commissioning activity, later revival plan or current Existing label is not sufficient evidence of full target-year operation. Facilities failing the 2024 operational gate do not enter numeric PI candidate discovery.
audits.drakelow: Current lifecycle evidence places full operation in March 2025. Commissioning/pre-operational context is not promoted into 2024 annual mass.
audits.thameside: The January 2024 permit is identity/regulatory evidence only; May 2024 construction-not-started status prevents a 2024 operational emissions candidate.
audits.medworth: Permit issue in May 2024 does not imply operation. Construction began only in 2025.
audits.hoddesdon: A valid historic permit is not evidence of 2024 operation after mothballing. Revival intent is not substituted for actual operation.
audits.sinfin: Historic permit and prior trial history are not used as 2024 operational evidence; council records show rectification/operator procurement context rather than operation.
audits.beccles: Local permit/application material describes the proposed plant; later construction timing excludes 2024 operational PI inference.
audits.direct_row_policy: No direct official 2024 PI facility row was consumed in this pass; direct_official_pi_rows_read remains zero.
audits.zero_policy: Non-operation, absence of a PI row and permit-only context are never converted to zero emissions.
